name: Phantom That Still Dwells
source:
A lonely secondary school senior, named Mayo, is trying to make friends in her final week. But she struggles with socialising and can't seem to get rid of this feeling of paranoia. Help her learn to calm her nerves and make new friends!

[From [url=https://chaireaa.itch.io/phantom-that-still-dwells]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位名叫梅奥的孤独的中学高年级学生正在努力在最后一周结交朋友。但她在社交方面遇到了困难，而且似乎无法摆脱这种偏执的感觉。帮助她学会平静情绪并结交新朋友！

[来自[url=https://chaireaa.itch.io/phantom-that-still-dwells]Itch.io[/url]]
